biotools.summary: QPAML (Qualitative Perturbation Analysis and Machine Learning) is a computational framework that integrates constraint-based metabolic modeling with supervised machine learning to predict genetic engineering targets for metabolite overproduction. By combining parsimonious Flux Balance Analysis (pFBA) and Flux Scanning based on Enforced Objective Flux (FSEOF) on genome-scale metabolic models, QPAML extracts qualitative flux redistribution descriptors under progressive target perturbations. These topological and flux-response features train Gradient Boosting Decision Trees (GBDT) on experimentally validated strain data, enabling accurate, computationally efficient classification of optimal enzymatic interventions—such as gene knockouts, upregulations, and downregulations—without requiring detailed kinetic parameters.
biotools.name: QPAML
